prompts.pnlText: Give me a crisp executive breakdown of my revenue, expenses, and net profit this month compared to last month.
prompts.expensesText: Which expense categories grew the most this month, and which transactions are missing a receipt?
prompts.invoicesText: Which customer invoices are currently unpaid or overdue, and what is the total outstanding balance?
prompts.budgetsText: Check all my active budgets right now and highlight any approaching or exceeding their limit.
prompts.derjaText: Kadeh sraft hal chhar w chniya akther masarif?
prompts.coverageText: What financial domains do you have verified access to for my business right now, and what is excluded?
